words.example_en: If we're too loud, the coach will kick us out.

words.example_en: Anyone who is ill should isolate themselves.

words.example_en: I got a rash from the new washing powder.

words.example_en: The history book says how big the Roman army was.

words.example_en: Our class was allowed to watch a trial in the courtroom.

words.example_en: Wow, you've cooked really well!

words.example_en: There are frogs in the pond behind the house.

words.example_en: My profile is only visible to friends.

words.example_en: According to the report the man was unarmed.

words.example_en: There's an old mill next to the river.

words.example_de: Ich muss noch die leeren Flaschen wegbringen.
words.example_en: I still have to take the empty bottles away.

words.example_en: We have a pact: nobody says anything.

words.example_en: Can you zoom in on the picture?

words.example_en: What did you wear at the party yesterday?

words.example_de: Die Katze hat unter dem Auto Unterschlupf gesucht.
words.example_en: The cat took shelter under the car.

words.example_en: On the head teacher's orders, lessons are cancelled.

words.example_en: You should always report online harassment.

words.example_en: I got a mysterious message.

words.example_en: I really benefited from the tutoring.

words.example_en: After the exam I'm rewarding myself with a pizza.

words.example_en: Why are you grinning like that?

words.example_en: Germany is a federation of 16 states.

words.note: + dative; Ich fühle mich geschmeichelt = I'm flattered
words.example_de: Danke, ich fühle mich geschmeichelt!
words.example_en: Thanks, I'm flattered!

words.example_en: Candles and soft music – so much romance!

words.example_en: The family has a housekeeper who cooks and cleans.

words.example_en: My favourite book is about a private detective.

words.example_en: We hung out in the park all afternoon.

words.example_en: Stay at home, the flu is contagious.

words.example_en: Chess is good training for mental fitness.

words.example_en: After the defeat everyone was really down.
